nina_billing: Acquirer opened a CHARGEBACK on INV-126600 for ProPlan annual. Reason: promo_abuse / 'unauthorized discount' claimed. Need evidence packet by EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: Alert: DISPUTE_OPEN id=dp_Z4q5 amount=2400.00 currency=USD reason=promo_abuse open_ts=1970012300

rita_support: Ticket #8140 thread says customer says 'we never got that discount, someone applied it without approval'. But chat shows account admin applied promo code PR-TEAM2026 at 2026-04-01 14:02 UTC. I'll attach transcript and promo audit.

evan_fraud: Quick triage: Promo code usage requires admin role; promo audit shows user id u-332 (admin) used it. No multiple accounts created around same time. Gateway auth and capture look normal. Recommend submit: invoice, promo audit log, support transcript, admin action log, and billing ledger.

sam_ops: Uploaded logs: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-126600/promo_audit_PR-TEAM2026.log and s3://redwood-disputes/INV-126600/admin_actions.csv. Also webhook receipts for invoice and promo application.

jules_legal: For promo abuse claims we need proof of who authorized the promo (admin id, IP), promo terms screenshot, invoice PDF, and redacted transcript. Avoid calling it 'abuse' in the narrative; stick to actions and timestamps.

nina_billing: Core txn summary I'm adding to packet: 

Charge ID: ch_PromoX99
Invoice: INV-126600
Amount after promo: $2,400.00
Promo: PR-TEAM2026 applied by user u-332 (admin) 2026-04-01T14:02Z
Open reason: promo_abuse

billing-bot: Reminder: evidence window = 5 business days. Time left ~4d 23h.

evan_fraud: Drafting submission note: include admin role verification and IP match between promo application and later invoice acceptance. Will attach gateway receipt and audit files.

rita_support: Redacted transcript uploaded to disputes bucket. Excerpt: > admin: "Applying PR-TEAM2026 for our team" > agent: "Promo applied, invoice updated."

jules_legal: Reviewing uploads now. If acquirer requests, we can provide signed admin approval policy excerpt.

nina_billing: Evidence uploaded to Disputes Dashboard: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-126600 . Tagging @jules_legal and @evan_fraud for final sign-off.

evan_fraud: Reviewed. Minor ask: attach identity verification logs for user u-332. I'll add and then submit.

nina_billing: Added identity proof logs and submitted evidence. :white_check_mark:
